result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS (4: 1 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM) at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Scope: OpenCode request/response/session semantics, errors, history/status interpretation, compatibility assumptions vs @opencode-ai/sdk@1.18.31 (src/providers/opencode.ts + coordinator/domain consumers). F1 HIGH src/providers/opencode.ts:166,184: any /session/status body that is not a record keyed by session id (null/array/string) yields undefined and is read as 'idle' = settled, so a busy turn is marked completed from the first completed reply; reproduced (state=running -> completed). The adapter is strict about an unrecognized 'type' (-> unknown) but never validates the body shape, and tests assert null -> idle. F2 MEDIUM src/providers/opencode.ts:113-129: every poll re-walks the whole history, uncapped and uncached; measured 202 requests/3.3s for a 20k-message session, 156 requests for 3 polls of 5k; an overlapping page makes inspect() throw and the worker stay non-terminal until its deadline. F3 MEDIUM src/providers/opencode.ts:142 + coordinator.ts:597: only info.error.name is kept, discarding data.message/statusCode/providerID, and replies require m.completed so an errored message without time.completed is dropped. F4 MEDIUM src/providers/opencode.ts:79-82: session.get 404 throws (throwOnError) instead of falling through to the deterministic-title recreate, so a wiped session fails as 'Provisioning timed out' after 300s. Request shapes themselves (list/messages/status/prompt_async/abort, baseUrl/throwOnError/headers/fetch) all match the pinned SDK: no defect there. Tests: bun 1.4.2, targeted 3 files, exit 0, 32 pass/0 fail. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json; log /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/rev28-targeted.log. No source changes; /workspace/repo untouched at 5672ead.
result.details:
Method: pristine detached clone at /tmp/rev28/work (git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895), runnable copy at /tmp/rev28/probe, @opencode-ai/sdk@1.18.31 unpacked at /tmp/rev28/sdk/package to verify every request/response shape, Bun 1.4.2 at /tmp/rev28/bunhome (lockfile untouched). /workspace/repo left at assigned baseline 5672ead and clean.

F1 (HIGH, reproduced) src/providers/opencode.ts:166 reads sessionStatus(status.data?.[id]?.type); line 184 maps undefined to idle. index access returns undefined for null, arrays, strings and any non-record body, so an unrecognized /session/status SHAPE is read as 'the turn finished' (coordinator.ts:560 settled=true). probe1: idle for absent key, null, array and string bodies; unknown only for an unrecognized type. Coordinator impact reproduced: a session genuinely busy with one completed reply plus a second streaming reply goes state=running -> state=completed result="FIRST" when the body is an array. Why guards miss it: the deliberate unknown-status handling and its test cover new 'type' values only, and tests/session-status.test.ts asserts null -> idle, locking the behavior in. Fix: return 'unknown' unless data is a non-array object; only a well-formed record missing the key means idle.

F2 (MEDIUM, measured) src/providers/opencode.ts:113-129 loops 'while (page.length === 100)' with no cap and no per-worker memo, so monitor() re-fetches the entire history every tick. probe2 at 15ms RTT: 100 msgs -> 3 req/37ms, 1k -> 12/178ms, 5k -> 52/829ms, 20k -> 202/3262ms; 3 polls of a 5k session -> 156 req. With MAX_WORKERS=50 and POLL_INTERVAL_MS=2000 this is thousands of round trips per second, and runTick's Promise.allSettled makes each tick cost the slowest walk. A failed page (throwOnError) discards the whole snapshot. probe2 also shows an overlapping page -> inspect() throws 'OpenCode message pagination did not advance'; probe3 A shows the worker then stuck non-terminal in 'running' with 'Provider or OpenCode operation failed; retrying within deadline'. Unverified hypothesis on the same lines: the cursor page.map(m=>m.info.id).sort()[0] assumes lexicographic order equals chronological order, and SwarmForge mixes its own ids in (src/store.ts:217).

F3 (MEDIUM, code-evidenced) src/providers/opencode.ts:142 keeps only info.error.name; the pinned SDK puts message/statusCode/isRetryable/providerID in info.error.data, so coordinator.ts:597 reports only 'OpenCode session failed (APIError)'. Unverified hypothesis: coordinator.ts:581-584 requires m.completed, so an errored assistant message without time.completed is excluded and the worker later dies with the unrelated 'No token progress' message.

F4 (MEDIUM, reproduced) src/providers/opencode.ts:79-82 returns the saved session id after session.get; with throwOnError a 404/410 throws, so the deterministic-title search/create fallback is unreachable for a recorded-but-gone session. probe3 B: state=booting with 'Provider or OpenCode operation failed; retrying within deadline', then state=failed error='Provisioning timed out' after the provision timeout. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:22 claims title-based recovery, but only for the not-yet-recorded case.

No defect found in the request shapes: session.list({search,limit}), session.messages({limit,before}), session.status(), session.prompt_async({messageID,model,system,parts}), session.abort and client fields baseUrl/throwOnError/headers/fetch/directory all match the pinned SDK types.

Limitations: full suite not run (whole-suite scope); no real OpenCode server, provider or network smoke; server-side ordering, time.completed on errored messages, and the worker image's OpenCode version are unverified. No credentials in any artifact.

result.followup_reason: Actionable defects in the OpenCode status/history interpretation: (1) HIGH - a non-record /session/status body is read as a finished turn and silently completes a busy worker (src/providers/opencode.ts:166,184); (2) MEDIUM - uncapped, uncached full-history re-fetch on every poll plus a hard throw that wedges the worker until its deadline (src/providers/opencode.ts:113-129); (3) MEDIUM - OpenCode error detail discarded and errored incomplete messages dropped (src/providers/opencode.ts:142, coordinator.ts:581,597); (4) MEDIUM - a lost saved session fails as 'Provisioning timed out' instead of being recreated (src/providers/opencode.ts:79-82). Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json.
